en.intro: This 561-page paperback by Christopher Scordo collects 1000+ PMP practice questions with answers and detailed solutions. FeelBetter buys it from the US seller after you order and ships it to Korea.
highlights: More than 1000 practice questions, as named in the title, give you plenty of material to work through.
Questions come with answers and detailed explanations, so you can learn from your mistakes.
A 561-page paperback published by SSI LOGIC on April 5, 2018.
ISBN-13 978-0989470346 and ISBN-10 0989470342 let you match the exact edition.
Large format of about 20.3 x 25.4 cm (8 x 10 in), roughly 3.2 cm thick.

sections.p: Use the questions to test yourself, then read the detailed solutions to see why each answer is right. The book is written in English.

sections.h: Size and who it is for
sections.p: The book measures about 20.3 x 25.4 x 3.2 cm and weighs about 2.42 pounds (roughly 1.1 kg), so it is a large, heavy paperback. It suits PMP candidates who are comfortable studying in English and want a large bank of practice questions.

cautions: English-language edition, not a Korean translation.
Published in 2018, so it may not follow the current PMP exam outline; the listing does not state which edition it covers.

de.intro: Dieses Taschenbuch von Christopher Scordo hat 561 Seiten und enthält über 1000 PMP-Übungsfragen mit Antworten und ausführlichen Lösungen. Nach Ihrer Bestellung kauft FeelBetter es beim US-Händler und schickt es Ihnen nach Korea.
